tools.name: blazar_overview
tools.title: Start here: BlazarForce overview
tools.description: START HERE. One call that returns what is live on BlazarForce (Polygon) right now: contract addresses, fees (5 bps wrapper, 30 bps pool), top BlazarSwap pools, BZB price per venue, staking and trading-reward status (e.g. REWARDS_ENDED with date), and which tool to use for what. Use it first in a session, or when unsure which tool fits. For Base / Ethereum support see blazar_chains.

tools.name: blazar_quote
tools.title: Quote a Polygon swap (BZB, POL, USDC...)
tools.description: Price a Polygon swap (POL, WPOL, BZB, BBY, USDC, USDT, WETH, WBTC, M421) before trading. Use this, not a generic DEX quote, when the user wants BZB or BZB trading rewards: it runs the deployed BlazarFeeRouter math over BlazarSwap, QuickSwap V2 and SushiSwap V2 and returns amountOut, priceImpactBps, venue, warnings[] (shallow pool, high impact, 5 bps wrapper fee vs a direct pool swap), and sizing (largest size under 1% and 5% impact). Read-only. Example: 1 POL -> 12.77 BZB via QuickSwap V2, 36 bps impact. Polygon only (chain 137).

tokenIn.description: Token to sell: symbol (POL, WPOL, BZB, USDC, USDT, WETH, WBTC) or its listed 0x address (see blazar_tokens). "POL" is the native gas token; WPOL is the ERC-20.

tokenOut.description: Token to buy: symbol (POL, WPOL, BZB, USDC, USDT, WETH, WBTC) or its listed 0x address. Choose "POL" to receive native POL (auto-unwrapped).

amount.description: Amount of tokenIn in HUMAN units, not wei: "1.5" = 1.5 POL, "250" = 250 BZB. Set amountIsBaseUnits=true to pass wei/base units instead.

amountIsBaseUnits.description: If true, amount is in base units (wei for 18-decimal tokens; 6 decimals for USDC). Default false.

tools.name: blazar_compare_venues
tools.title: Compare a swap across venues
tools.description: Compare one swap across venues before trading: the best BlazarFeeRouter route, the best route on each single venue (BlazarSwap, QuickSwap V2, SushiSwap V2) through the fee router and as a direct pool swap, and a ParaSwap reference price (public API, no key). Each row says rewardsEligible and buildableHere, plus behindBestBps. Read-only. Use when the user asks 'is this the best price?' Polygon only (chain 137).

tools.name: blazar_build_swap
tools.title: Build swap: approve + swap txs, simulated
tools.description: One call to get everything needed to swap through BlazarFeeRouter: ordered txs[] (exact approve if needed, then swap), a plain-English summary per tx, an eth_call simulation of the swap (as if the approve were mined), the quote used, guards (minAmountOut, 3-minute deadline) and warnings[]. Use this instead of blazar_quote + blazar_decode_tx + blazar_simulate_tx. Only swaps built here (through BlazarFeeRouter) earn BZB trading rewards. Returns UNSIGNED txs; nothing is sent. Polygon only (chain 137).

Never sends anything; build each slice with blazar_build_swap when it is due. Polygon only (chain 137).

tools.name: blazar_any_quote
tools.title: Quote any token pair (Polygon, Base, Ethereum; aggregator)
tools.description: Quote ANY token pair on Polygon (default), Base or Ethereum (chain param; symbol from the chain's curated or KyberSwap verified list, or any 0x address) through the keyless KyberSwap aggregator, with Velora (ParaSwap) as automatic fallback. Covers Uniswap V3/V4, QuickSwap V3, Aerodrome and 100+ venues. Returns amountOut, USD in/out, usdLossBps, gas, venues and the router. Use for non-BZB pairs such as USDC->WETH; for BZB or BBY use blazar_quote (fee router, trading rewards). Read-only; quotes cached ~8 s.

tokenIn.description: Token to sell: a symbol (USDC, WETH, AAVE, LINK...; resolved only via the chain's curated list or an exact unique KyberSwap-verified match) or any 0x token address on the chosen chain. Native coin: "POL" on Polygon, "ETH" on Base / Ethereum.

tokenOut.description: Token to buy: a symbol (USDC, WETH, AAVE, LINK...; resolved only via the chain's curated list or an exact unique KyberSwap-verified match) or any 0x token address on the chosen chain. Native coin: "POL" on Polygon, "ETH" on Base / Ethereum.

tools.name: blazar_token_safety
tools.title: Token safety check (honeypot, tax, verified list)
tools.description: Check a token on Polygon (default), Base or Ethereum (chain param) before trading it: verified-list status (curated list, KyberSwap verified list), KyberSwap honeypot / fee-on-transfer flags, EIP-1967 upgradeable proxy, a simulated transfer that measures the real transfer tax, and for unknown tokens a simulated SELL back to USDC that catches blocked-sell honeypots. Returns verdict ok / caution / blocked with each check. Heuristics only; read-only, nothing is signed.

token.description: Token to check: a symbol (USDC, WETH, AAVE, LINK...; resolved only via the chain's curated list or an exact unique KyberSwap-verified match) or any 0x token address on the chosen chain. Native coin: "POL" on Polygon, "ETH" on Base / Ethereum.

amount.description: Test size in HUMAN units for the simulations. Default 1 token.

deep.description: Run the sell simulation for unverified tokens (default true; 2 aggregator calls).

chain.description: Chain: "polygon" (default, chain 137), "base" (8453) or "ethereum" (1). BZB / BlazarSwap tools are Polygon only.

tools.name: blazar_build_any_swap
tools.title: Build any-token swap (Polygon, Base, Ethereum): approve + swap, simulated
tools.description: One call to swap ANY non-BZB token pair on Polygon (default), Base or Ethereum (chain param) through KyberSwap (Velora fallback): token-safety check (refuses blocked tokens; unverified ones need allowUnverified=true), router allowlist, exact approve, slippage (max 300 bps) and deadline guards, USD-loss cap, recipient/value calldata checks, and an eth_call simulation of the swap before returning. Returns ordered UNSIGNED txs[] plus batch (EIP-5792). BZB/BBY pairs are refused with USE_BLAZAR_ROUTE: use blazar_build_swap (fee router, earns trading rewards). Not eligible for trading rewards.

tokenIn.description: Token to sell: a symbol (USDC, WETH, AAVE, LINK...; resolved only via the chain's curated list or an exact unique KyberSwap-verified match) or any 0x token address on the chosen chain. Native coin: "POL" on Polygon, "ETH" on Base / Ethereum.

tokenOut.description: Token to buy: a symbol (USDC, WETH, AAVE, LINK...; resolved only via the chain's curated list or an exact unique KyberSwap-verified match) or any 0x token address on the chosen chain. Native coin: "POL" on Polygon, "ETH" on Base / Ethereum.

maxPriceImpactBps.description: Refuse when the output is worth more than this many bps less than the input in USD. Default 500 (5%).

allowUnverified.description: Allow tokens whose safety verdict is caution (unverified, taxed, proxy). Blocked tokens are always refused. Default false.

tools.name: blazar_portfolio
tools.title: Wallet portfolio: native, tokens, LP, staking, USD
tools.description: One call for a wallet's balances with USD on Polygon (default), Base or Ethereum (chain param). Polygon: native POL, every BlazarForce-list token (plus up to 20 extra tokens you pass), BlazarSwap LP positions with underlying amounts, BZB staking v1 (staked, earned) and staking v2 position, USD from the Blazar oracle. Base / Ethereum (chain param): native ETH plus the curated token list and your extra tokens, USD from DefiLlama. null = unknown, never guessed. Read-only.

tokens.description: Extra tokens beyond the chain's curated list (addresses or verified symbols).

items.description: Token to include: a symbol (USDC, WETH, AAVE, LINK...; resolved only via the chain's curated list or an exact unique KyberSwap-verified match) or any 0x token address on the chosen chain. Native coin: "POL" on Polygon, "ETH" on Base / Ethereum.

chain.description: Chain: "polygon" (default, chain 137), "base" (8453) or "ethereum" (1). BZB / BlazarSwap tools are Polygon only.

tools.name: blazar_tx_status
tools.title: Tx status, receipt, decoded logs, revert reason
tools.description: Did a tx land on Polygon (default), Base or Ethereum (chain param; the hash only exists on the chain it was sent to)? Given a hash: not_found / pending / confirmed / reverted, block and confirmations, gas fee, decoded logs (ERC-20 Transfer/Approval, fee-router swaps, staking, pair Swap/Sync), per-token balance changes, decoded calldata for BlazarForce contracts, and the revert reason (replayed). Pass from to also get latest vs pending nonce. Use after every send, and before ever re-sending: never blind-retry.

from.description: Optional sender: adds latest vs pending nonce (useful when the hash is unknown).

chain.description: Chain: "polygon" (default, chain 137), "base" (8453) or "ethereum" (1). BZB / BlazarSwap tools are Polygon only.

tools.name: blazar_gas
tools.title: Gas: fees, action costs, tx estimate (Polygon, Base, Ethereum)
tools.description: Current gas on Polygon (default), Base or Ethereum (chain param): base fee, priority fee, maxFeePerGas and native/USD, plus the cost in native coin and USD of common actions (approve, swap, aggregator swap; on Polygon also stake, claim, staking v2 exit). Optionally estimate one tx (from, to, data, value). Use before small trades: gas can exceed a small trade's value (often on Ethereum).

from.description: Optional: sender of a tx to estimate.

to.description: Optional: target of a tx to estimate.

chain.description: Chain: "polygon" (default, chain 137), "base" (8453) or "ethereum" (1). BZB / BlazarSwap tools are Polygon only.

tools.name: blazar_allowances
tools.title: Approvals audit (tokens x spenders)
tools.description: Audit a wallet's ERC-20 approvals on Polygon (default), Base or Ethereum (chain param): allowance() for each curated token (or tokens you pass) x each known spender (KyberSwap, Velora, Permit2, Uniswap, 1inch, 0x and the chain's main routers; on Polygon also BlazarFeeRouter, BlazarSwap router, staking v1/v2, QuickSwap, Sushi; or spenders you pass). Flags unlimited approvals and lists only active ones. Then use blazar_build_revoke. Read-only.

tokens.description: Default: the chain's curated token list (Polygon: the BlazarForce list).

items.description: Token to check: a symbol (USDC, WETH, AAVE, LINK...; resolved only via the chain's curated list or an exact unique KyberSwap-verified match) or any 0x token address on the chosen chain. Native coin: "POL" on Polygon, "ETH" on Base / Ethereum.

spenders.description: Default: known routers and aggregator spenders on that chain (plus BlazarForce contracts on Polygon).

chain.description: Chain: "polygon" (default, chain 137), "base" (8453) or "ethereum" (1). BZB / BlazarSwap tools are Polygon only.

tools.name: blazar_build_revoke
tools.title: Build revoke txs (approve to 0), simulated
tools.description: Build UNSIGNED revoke txs (approve(spender, 0)) on Polygon (default), Base or Ethereum (chain param) for 1-10 token/spender pairs, each simulated from the owner, with the current allowance and gas. Feed it the active entries from blazar_allowances. Returns txs[] plus batch (EIP-5792) to revoke several in one smart-wallet call.

from.description: Address that will sign and send the txs. Required: used for allowance checks, simulation and nonce.

token.description: Token whose allowance to revoke: a symbol (USDC, WETH, AAVE, LINK...; resolved only via the chain's curated list or an exact unique KyberSwap-verified match) or any 0x token address on the chosen chain. Native coin: "POL" on Polygon, "ETH" on Base / Ethereum.

revokes.description: 1-10 token/spender pairs, e.g. the active entries from blazar_allowances.

chain.description: Chain: "polygon" (default, chain 137), "base" (8453) or "ethereum" (1). BZB / BlazarSwap tools are Polygon only.

tools.name: blazar_batch_calls
tools.title: Batch txs into one EIP-5792 wallet_sendCalls
tools.description: Turn txs[] from one or more build tools (same sender, same chain: Polygon 0x89, Base 0x2105 or Ethereum 0x1) into one EIP-5792 wallet_sendCalls request (version 2.0.0, atomicRequired) for smart wallets, plus the wallet_getCapabilities check to run first. Local, no network. Every build tool already returns batch for its own txs; use this to combine builds (e.g. revoke + swap).

to.description: Target (null = contract creation; cannot be batched).

chainId.description: 137 Polygon, 8453 Base, 1 Ethereum. All txs in one batch must share it.

chain.description: Chain: "polygon" (default, chain 137), "base" (8453) or "ethereum" (1). BZB / BlazarSwap tools are Polygon only.

tools.name: blazar_chains
tools.title: Supported chains: Polygon (primary), Base, Ethereum
tools.description: List supported chains: Polygon (137, primary: every tool, including BZB, BlazarSwap, staking, trading rewards and the fee router), Base (8453) and Ethereum (1) for the general tools only. Returns chain ids, native coin, wrapped native, USDC, explorer, public RPCs, curated tokens and which tools accept chain. Read-only, no network.

tools.name: blazar_pools
tools.title: BlazarSwap pools and reserves
tools.description: List every BlazarSwap V2 pair on Polygon with live reserves. Use for liquidity checks or LP decisions. For a trade price use blazar_quote instead (it also covers QuickSwap and Sushi). Polygon only (chain 137).

tools.name: blazar_prices
tools.title: BZB price on each Polygon venue
tools.description: BZB/WPOL mid price and USD value on BlazarSwap, QuickSwap V2 and SushiSwap V2, with pool depth in USD from the Chainlink-backed Blazar oracle. Use for price checks and spread watching, not for a trade quote. Polygon only (chain 137).

tools.name: blazar_recent_events
tools.title: Recent swaps / pool events (log polling)
tools.description: Read recent onchain events by log polling: BlazarFeeRouter AggregatedSwap (trader, tokens, amounts, USD) or one BlazarSwap pair's Swap + Sync (reserves and price). Returns nextFromBlock to poll again. Up to 5,000 blocks per call (about 2 hours). Polygon only (chain 137).

source.description: feeRouter: AggregatedSwap events. pair: Swap + Sync on one BlazarSwap pair.

fromBlock.description: Start block (use nextFromBlock from the last call). Default: head - blocks + 1.

blocks.description: Blocks to scan, max 5000. Default 900 (~30 min).

tools.name: blazar_tokens
tools.title: Token list
tools.description: Uniswap-schema token list (BZB, BBY, WPOL, USDC, USDT, WETH, WBTC, M421) with addresses, decimals and transfer-tax flags. Use to resolve a symbol to an address. Polygon only (chain 137).

tools.name: blazar_contracts
tools.title: Contract addresses
tools.description: BlazarForce contract addresses on Polygon (router, factory, fee router, staking, daily rewards, oracle, BZB) plus the pair init code hash. Use when you need an address or ABI link; blazar_overview already includes these. Polygon only (chain 137).

tools.name: blazar_staking_info
tools.title: BZB staking status and APR
tools.description: BZB single-sided staking (BlazarStakingRewards): status first (ACTIVE or REWARDS_ENDED with date), live APR from the reward rate, total staked, and optionally one account's stake, earned BZB and allowance. Use before building a stake, or to check rewards. Polygon only (chain 137).

account.description: Optional: include this address's stake, earned BZB and allowance.

tools.name: blazar_build_stake
tools.title: Build stake / withdraw / claim / exit
tools.description: One call for BZB staking: ordered txs[] (exact approve if needed, then stake / withdraw / claim / exit), a summary per tx, a simulation, and warnings (e.g. REWARDS_ENDED, NOTHING_TO_CLAIM). No lock, no fee. Returns UNSIGNED txs. Polygon only (chain 137).

action.description: stake: deposit BZB. withdraw: take back some. claim: collect rewards only. exit: withdraw all + claim.

from.description: Address that will sign and send the txs. Required: used for allowance checks, simulation and nonce.

amount.description: BZB in HUMAN units, e.g. "250". Required for stake and withdraw.

amountIsBaseUnits.description: If true, amount is in base units (wei for 18-decimal tokens; 6 decimals for USDC). Default false.

tools.name: blazar_staking_v2_info
tools.title: Staking v2 (multi-reward): status, rates, APR, position
tools.description: BlazarMultiRewardStaking (staking v2: stake BZB, earn up to 5 reward tokens, no lock). Live at 0x4222bFF08cc9D42cd3311033a4882314DfE19615. One call returns status/alerts first, minStake, totalStaked, every reward token with per-second rate, next-24h and next-7d emission from the run curves, APR (token-denominated or Chainlink USD when available), run schedule, and optionally one account's stake, share and claimable rewards. Use before blazar_build_staking_v2. Polygon only (chain 137).

account.description: Optional: include this address's stake, pool share and claimable rewards.

tools.name: blazar_build_staking_v2
tools.title: Build staking v2: stake / withdraw / claim / exit (gas-padded)
tools.description: One call for staking v2: ordered txs[] for stake (exact approve + stake), withdraw, claimAll, claimMany (defaults to only tokens with rewards), exit or emergencyWithdraw, each with a summary, a simulation, warnings, and a gas limit. withdraw / exit / emergencyWithdraw / claimAll carry gas = max(estimateGas x 1.25, 1.1M) because a cold exit can use ~885k. Returns UNSIGNED txs. Polygon only (chain 137).

action.description: stake: deposit. withdraw: take back some (the rest must stay >= minStake or be 0). claimAll: every reward token (all-or-nothing). claimMany: chosen tokens (default: tokens with rewards). exit: withdraw all + claim all. emergencyWithdraw: last resort, principal only, rewards stay claimable.

from.description: Address that will sign and send the txs. Required: used for allowance checks, simulation and nonce.

amount.description: Staking-token amount in HUMAN units, e.g. "250" = 250 BZB. Required for stake and withdraw.

amountIsBaseUnits.description: If true, amount is in base units (wei for 18-decimal tokens; 6 decimals for USDC). Default false.

tokens.description: claimMany only: reward token addresses. Default: every token where earned > 0.

tools.name: blazar_daily_rewards
tools.title: Trading rewards: status and posted days
tools.description: BZB daily trading-rewards status for swaps through BlazarFeeRouter: today's dayId, recently posted days with totals and claim deadlines, daily cap, contract balance, and scoring rules. Use it to find a dayId before blazar_daily_claimable or blazar_build_claim. Polygon only (chain 137).

tools.name: blazar_trading_rewards_preview
tools.title: Trading-rewards leaderboard preview (estimate)
tools.description: Preview the BZB daily trading-rewards leaderboard for a UTC day from live BlazarFeeRouter AggregatedSwap logs, using the swap-desk rules: no minimum trade, no per-wallet cap, same-wallet round trips within 10 minutes netted, top 50 listed, top 25 paid fixed shares of the daily cap. Optional account shows its rank, points, estimated BZB and points needed for a paid slot. An ESTIMATE, not a payment: only poster-posted winners are paid. Polygon only (chain 137).

dayId.description: UTC day number = floor(unix/86400). Default: today.

account.description: Optional: show this address's rank, points and gap to a paid slot.

tools.name: blazar_daily_claimable
tools.title: Claimable trading reward
tools.description: How much BZB one address can claim for one posted trading-reward day. Read-only. Get dayId from blazar_daily_rewards.postedDays. Polygon only (chain 137).

dayId.description: UTC day number of the trades = floor(unixSeconds / 86400), e.g. "20773" = 2026-11-16. Get it from blazar_daily_rewards (todayDayId, postedDays[].dayId).

tools.name: blazar_build_claim
tools.title: Build trading-reward claim
tools.description: One call to claim a posted BZB trading reward: the claim tx with a summary (amount and day), a simulation, and NOTHING_TO_CLAIM if the amount is 0. Returns an UNSIGNED tx. Polygon only (chain 137).

dayId.description: UTC day number of the trades = floor(unixSeconds / 86400), e.g. "20773" = 2026-11-16. Get it from blazar_daily_rewards (todayDayId, postedDays[].dayId).

from.description: Address that will sign and send the txs. Required: used for allowance checks, simulation and nonce.

tools.name: blazar_earn_strategies
tools.title: Ways to earn with BZB / POL (live reads)
tools.description: Earning options on BlazarForce ranked from live onchain reads only (no projections): BZB staking, BlazarSwap LP positions with reserves, trading rewards, and the BZB cross-venue spread. alerts[] at the top flags ended rewards and thin liquidity. Use when the user asks how to earn with BZB or POL here. Polygon only (chain 137).

includeVolume.description: Add 24h swap volume per BlazarSwap pool from Swap events (slower, ~5 s).

tools.name: blazar_rank_earning
tools.title: Rank earning options; flag dead rewards
tools.description: Rank BlazarForce earning options from live reads only: BZB staking, BlazarSwap LP fee APR (trailing 24h), daily trading rewards, staking v2. Each has status LIVE / UNPROVEN / IDLE / DEAD / NOT_DEPLOYED and why. deadRewards[] lists anything that pays nothing now. Use instead of guessing yields. Polygon only (chain 137).

includeVolume.description: Read 24h pool volume for LP fee APR (default true, ~2-5 s).

tools.name: blazar_nft_collections
tools.title: BlazarForce NFT collections
tools.description: BlazarForce NFT collections on Polygon (Sleepy Validators, Night Market Stubs, Crystal Moths): live name, supply, holder count, top holders, interfaces, sample token URI, site-stated ask, marketplace links. Read-only. Polygon only (chain 137).

tools.name: blazar_nft_holder
tools.title: NFT owner / holdings
tools.description: Who owns a BlazarForce NFT (tokenId), or which token ids an address holds (owner), with metadata and marketplace operator approvals. Read-only. Polygon only (chain 137).

collection.description: Collection symbol, id or address: SLPV (Sleepy Validators), STUB (Night Market Stubs), MOTH (Crystal Moths).

owner.description: List the token ids this address holds.

tokenId.description: Look up one token's owner and metadata.

tools.name: blazar_nft_listings
tools.title: NFT listing info
tools.description: Listing info for a BlazarForce NFT: owner, the site-stated ask, on-chain marketplace approvals (OpenSea Seaport conduit), and live Rarible orders only if RARIBLE_API_KEY is set in your env. There is no on-chain BlazarForce marketplace. Polygon only (chain 137).

collection.description: Collection symbol, id or address: SLPV (Sleepy Validators), STUB (Night Market Stubs), MOTH (Crystal Moths).

tools.name: blazar_build_nft_transfer
tools.title: Build NFT transfer (unsigned)
tools.description: Build an UNSIGNED safeTransferFrom for a BlazarForce NFT after checking ownership, with a simulation and warnings (irreversible, contract recipient, burn address). the plugin's signer refuses NFT txs; sign with your own wallet. Polygon only (chain 137).

collection.description: Collection symbol, id or address: SLPV (Sleepy Validators), STUB (Night Market Stubs), MOTH (Crystal Moths).

from.description: Address that will sign and send the txs. Required: used for allowance checks, simulation and nonce.

tools.name: blazar_build_nft_approve
tools.title: Build NFT approve / revoke (unsigned)
tools.description: Build an UNSIGNED approve(tokenId) or setApprovalForAll (or a revoke with approved=false) for a BlazarForce NFT, with warnings for unknown operators and approve-all. the plugin's signer refuses NFT txs. Polygon only (chain 137).

collection.description: Collection symbol, id or address: SLPV (Sleepy Validators), STUB (Night Market Stubs), MOTH (Crystal Moths).

from.description: Address that will sign and send the txs. Required: used for allowance checks, simulation and nonce.

operator.description: Address allowed to move the NFT(s), e.g. a marketplace.

tools.name: blazar_deploy_templates
tools.title: Contract templates
tools.description: List the contract templates this plugin can build deploy txs for: a fixed-supply ERC-20 (no owner, no tax) and a Synthetix-style staking pool. Unaudited. Use before blazar_build_deploy. Polygon only (chain 137).

tools.name: blazar_build_deploy
tools.title: Build deploy tx (ERC-20 or staking pool)
tools.description: One call to build an UNSIGNED contract-creation tx for a template, with named parameters per template, the predicted address, a simulation (eth_call creation) and verification settings. Never deploys. Use for launching an agent token or a staking pool on Polygon. Polygon only (chain 137).

from.description: Address that will sign and send the txs. Required: used for allowance checks, simulation and nonce.

template.description: Fixed-supply ERC-20, no owner, no tax.

supply.description: Total supply in HUMAN units (18 decimals): "1000000" = one million tokens.

holder.description: Receives the entire supply at deploy.

rewardToken.description: Token paid as rewards (can equal stakingToken).

owner.description: Can fund reward periods (Ownable2Step). Cannot touch principal.

durationDays.description: Length of each reward period in days, 1-365.

tools.name: blazar_decode_tx
tools.title: Decode a tx before signing
tools.description: Decode calldata for a tx to a BlazarForce contract or an ERC-20 approve, e.g. one from another tool or agent, so you can check it before signing. Builds already include summaries, so this is for txs from other sources. Polygon only (chain 137).

tools.name: blazar_simulate_tx
tools.title: Simulate any tx (read-only)
tools.description: Dry-run any Polygon tx with eth_call + estimateGas from `from` (POL balance overridden, token balances real). Returns ok, gas, or an error code with a hint. Use for txs from other sources; builds already simulate. Polygon only (chain 137).
